BiblicalUsage: Sha'as is plundering, spoiling, and Jeremiah turns it back on the plunderers: all they that devour thee shall be devoured, and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the spoiler is spoiled in the end — what was taken from Israel is taken from the takers.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
